gates.familyAndLevel: The sole change is cancellation liability, not the result of the test. Prices, signal validity, probability, payoff timing and decision authority constant. Middle must weigh 12 expected upside from early delivery against .6c conditional loss while still funding informative test for 2; merely knowing the success threshold cannot settle the order. Two distinct sequences (secure time before learning or postpone commitment until after learning).
gates.contentMapping: §13.2 explicitly recommends the cheapest valid prototype before committing to a costly feature and defining evidence in advance. Both winners separate proof from actual development and avoid unconditional spend. Holding evidence quality fixed isolates how to sequence commitment; the section does not supply an option-price formula. product_and_uncertainty→product; cheap-learning-before-build/hypothesis/reversible-investment→uncertainty per Swift.
